qa_pairs.question: What is the section number for Body in the service manual?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 41 covers Body procedures and components.

qa_pairs.question: What page should I reference for side member cover replacement on 4-door cars?
qa_pairs.answer: Page 41-111 covers side member cover replacement for left or right on 4-door cars.

qa_pairs.question: Where can I find information about trunk floor plate assembly replacement?
qa_pairs.answer: Trunk floor plate assembly replacement with tail panel removed is covered on page 41-118.

qa_pairs.question: What procedure is described on page 41-122?
qa_pairs.answer: Page 41-122 covers wheel house, front, left replacement procedures.

qa_pairs.question: Which page covers complete wheel house and side panel replacement for the rear right?
qa_pairs.answer: Page 41-129 covers wheel house complete and side panel, rear, right replacement procedures.

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference between procedures 41 11 101 and 41 11 121?
qa_pairs.answer: Procedure 41 11 101 is for complete side member cover replacement on 4-door cars, while 41 11 121 is for partial replacement without removal of door on 2-door cars.
